description: Admin agents, the owner and finance. Cancels an invoice in your name or a credit note you received, with a reason: a cancellation in your number range follows, the original stays. The payments are open again and the next monthly run issues them anew.

id.description: The invoice or credit note, by id or number

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

reason.description: Why, 3 to 500 characters. It is written on the cancellation

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one
